Welcome to Sparta Co-op Services!
Sparta Co-op Services was established in 1996 from the merging of Sparta Co-Op Exchange (originally formed in 1919) and Sparta Co-Op Oil (originally formed in 1931). This combination gave Sparta Co-op Services an established consumer clientele teaming up with our farming community patrons to give us a diversity necessary for us to flourish in any business climate. Our mission is to provide our patrons with top notch products and services at fair and competitive prices. That requires continual investment in facilities, equipment, technology and our people in order to do our best for our customers.
Our Grain and Fertilizer Departments are focused on helping our area farming community patrons navigate their ever-changing needs and challenges. Mr. Tire has the automotive products and services to keep the wheels rolling on older and late model vehicles alike. Our Propane Department delivery business has thrived by giving great, dependable customer service for heating fuel when you need it most. And the Sparta Coop Cenex convenience store is the friendliest store in town for all your fuel, snacks, soft drinks, deli cravings and fresh made pizzas.
All this in a business that is locally owned and operated with local employees. Our families and friends are our customers, and that's the way we like it. Stop in or call. You'll be glad you did!
Hwy. 27 Cenex
Visit our store! Awesome food offerings like breakfast sandwiches, deli cravings and pizza, a beer cave and a bigger selection of snacks. Bigger, brighter but best of all, the same great Cenex Team ready to assist you. Still the friendliest stop in Sparta.
The attached Arby's restaurant has become a big hit in the community. Food & Fuel at Arby's and Cenex. Can't beat that!
